items.answer: Full-time employees with three or more years of service accrue 1.50 days of PTO per month.

Security and acceptable-use training must be completed within 14 calendar days of the start date. It is the only training with a hard deadline shorter than 30 days, because system access is granted on day one and the risk starts with it.

The full required set for every employee is: security and acceptable use, data protection and privacy, anti-harassment and respectful workplace, and anti-bribery and corruption. All four are completed within 30 calendar days of the start date.

Benefits enrolment opens in week one even though coverage does not begin until the 90-day waiting period ends. Enrolling early means the elections are in place when eligibility arrives.

Payroll setup, tax withholding elections and 401(k) enrolment are completed in week one. The 401(k) has no waiting period, so a new hire may begin contributing from their first payroll run.

IT ships standard equipment to arrive at least 5 business days before the start date. The shipment goes to the employee's home address for remote and hybrid hires and to their assigned office for onsite hires, and it contains the laptop, adapter, headset and, for remote hires, the monitor, keyboard, mouse and dock described in the Equipment & Asset Policy.

Every employee is issued a standard laptop configured for their role, a power adapter, a headset and a laptop bag. The standard configurations for 2026 are a 14-inch developer laptop with 32 GB of memory for engineering roles, and a 13-inch laptop with 16 GB of memory for all other roles.

New hires become eligible for medical, dental and vision coverage 90 days after their hire date. Coverage begins on the day the waiting period ends, not on the first of the following month.

Next steps:
- Complete security and acceptable-use training by day 14
- Complete all four required trainings (security, data protection, anti-harassment, anti-bribery) by day 30
- Complete benefits election in week one; confirm elections at 90-day check-in before coverage begins
- Receive and set up standard laptop and peripherals before start date

You must have completed at least 12 months of continuous service to work outside your home country. As of 2026-09-01, you have 45 months of tenure, so you meet this requirement.

Germany is an approved destination for temporary work abroad.

Your proposed stay from 3 November to 14 December 2026 is 42 calendar days. Stays over 30 consecutive days require director approval and a Tax & Legal review filed at least 21 calendar days before departure.

No employee may work outside their home country for more than 90 days in a rolling 12-month period. Days are counted as calendar days of presence, including weekends and company holidays.

Work performed outside your home country must use a company-managed, full-disk-encrypted laptop with always-on VPN. Personal devices may not be used for any Mosaic Robotics work outside your home country.

IT Security must be notified of the destination country at least 5 business days before departure so that conditional-access rules and travel-risk monitoring can be adjusted.

Recommendation — not company policy: Confirm with your manager and director that they will approve a 42-day stay. Raise your request in MosaicOne under 'Work from another country' with your exact start and end dates and the address of your Berlin workspace.

Recommendation — not company policy: File a Tax & Legal review request at least 21 calendar days before 3 November (by 13 October 2026). The review will determine whether shadow payroll, social security coverage, or other tax arrangements are required.

Recommendation — not company policy: Verify with IT Security that your travel laptop is company-managed, full-disk-encrypted and configured for always-on VPN, and notify them of your Berlin destination at least 5 business days before departure.

Recommendation — not company policy: Check your rolling 90-day usage in the past 12 months to confirm this 42-day stay will not exceed the annual limit. If you have used any days abroad recently, add them to this trip's duration.

Next steps:
- Obtain written manager approval at least 21 calendar days before departure.
- File a Tax & Legal review request by 13 October 2026.
- Notify IT Security of your Berlin destination by 25 October 2026 (5 business days before 3 November).
- Confirm your travel laptop meets encryption and VPN requirements.
- Verify your rolling 90-day balance for the 12-month period.

Mosaic Robotics policy routes harassment, discrimination, retaliation, legal threats, medical matters and pay disputes to a named People Operations partner, so I will not answer it here. Contact employee-relations@mosaicrobotics.example, or raise a case in MosaicOne under "Raise an HR case". You may also use the third-party ethics line anonymously.

Next steps:
- Email employee-relations@mosaicrobotics.example — a case needs only your name and a description of the matter.
- Or raise it yourself in MosaicOne under "Raise an HR case"; you will get a case reference.
- If you would like me to open an HR case for you, say so and I will show you the exact summary for your confirmation before anything is created.
Full-time employees with three or more years of service accrue 1.50 days of PTO per month.

Hybrid employees assigned to a hub office must work on site at least 3 days each week. The specific days are set by the team, not by the individual, to ensure team onsite days overlap and office time is collaborative. The requirement is measured as a rolling four-week average in MosaicOne, so a single unusual week is never a compliance problem.

New hires become eligible for medical, dental and vision coverage 90 days after their hire date. Coverage begins on the day the waiting period ends, not on the first of the following month.

Basic life insurance and accidental death and dismemberment cover begin when the medical waiting period ends.

The 401(k) retirement plan has no waiting period; employees may begin contributing from their first payroll run.

The waiting period is not restarted by an internal transfer, promotion, or change from part-time to full-time status, but is restarted by a break in service of more than 26 weeks.

Benefits enrollment opens in week one even though coverage does not begin until the 90-day waiting period ends, so elections are in place when eligibility arrives.

Next steps:
- Confirm your hire date to calculate your exact coverage start date
- Enroll in benefits during week one to ensure elections are active when your waiting period ends
- Review available plans in MosaicOne Benefits
